# Integriq

> API gateway and integration hub for Nextcloud: connects REST and SOAP sources, exposes API endpoints, transforms data with mappings and keeps systems in sync. Requires OpenRegister; every entity is stored as an OpenRegister object.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint and repo conventions for coding agents
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): translation (l10n) tooling and rules
- [README.md](README.md): overview, features, development and tests
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): architecture overview
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow and commit format

## Docs

- [docs/intro.md](docs/intro.md): introduction to the user documentation
- [docs/Installation/demo-environment.md](docs/Installation/demo-environment.md): local demo environment
- [docs/features/](docs/features/): one page per feature (sources, endpoints, mappings, jobs, events and more)
- [docs/administrators/](docs/administrators/): administration guides
- [docs/developers/](docs/developers/): developer guides, connector kit and style guide
- [docs/architecture/register-schema.md](docs/architecture/register-schema.md): register schema

## API

- [openapi.json](openapi.json): OpenAPI document for the app's HTTP API
- [openapi.standards.json](openapi.standards.json): endpoints that implement an external standard

## Specs and decisions

- [openspec/specs/](openspec/specs/): current capability specs
- [openspec/changes/](openspec/changes/): open changes; finished ones in `openspec/changes/archive/`
- [openspec/architecture/README.md](openspec/architecture/README.md): index of architecture decision records
- [openspec/config.yaml](openspec/config.yaml): project context and spec rules

## Configuration

- [src/manifest.json](src/manifest.json): frontend page manifest, with fragments in `src/manifest.d/`
- [lib/Settings/](lib/Settings/): connector templates and example configurations
